objectives.label: State your own choice
objectives.descriptorEN: State a first-person choice with 'Jaz bom + accusative'.

objectives.label: Name a pizza variety
objectives.descriptorEN: Name a pizza with correct adjective agreement (vegansko pico, pikantno pico).

objectives.label: Order the four-cheese
objectives.descriptorEN: Order 'pico s štirimi siri' with the instrumental.

intro.text: [hungry, restless] O, super, tukaj se da jesti. [stomach growls] ...ojoj, umiram od lakote. [laughs self-consciously] Cel dan nisem nič jedel. Rad bi eno veliko pikantno pico, pa hladno pivo. [dramatic pause] Dobro — gremo noter, preden pojem enega od teh turistov.
intro.en: Oh, great — you can eat here. …oh no, I'm starving. I haven't eaten all day. I'd like one big spicy pizza, and a cold beer. Alright — let's go in, before I eat one of these tourists.

m1.speaker: npc
m1.sl: Dober večer! Ste se že odločili?
m1.en: Good evening! Have you decided yet?
m1.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober večer! Ste se že odločili?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Hmm, kaj naj vzamem? Še razmišljam.
c1a.en: Hmm, what should I have? I'm still thinking.

m2.speaker: npc
m2.sl: Imamo vegansko, margarito, pikantno, pa pico s štirimi siri. Katero bi želeli?
m2.en: We have vegan, margherita, spicy, and a four-cheese pizza. Which would you like?
m2.deliverySL: [warmly] Imamo vegansko, margarito, pikantno, pa pico s štirimi siri. Katero bi želeli?

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.sl: Jaz bom pico s štirimi siri.

m2b.speaker: npc
m2b.sl: Pikantno, odlična izbira! Bi bolj blago ali pošteno pekočo?
m2b.en: Spicy, great choice! Would you like it milder or really hot?
m2b.deliverySL: [warmly] Pikantno, odlična izbira! Bi bolj blago ali pošteno pekočo?

m3.speaker: npc
m3.sl: Odlično. In kaj bodo vzeli vaši prijatelji?
m3.en: Perfect. And what will your friends have?
m3.deliverySL: [warmly] Odlično. In kaj bodo vzeli vaši prijatelji?

c3a.speaker: client
c3a.sl: Ana bo margarito, Marko pa pikantno.
c3a.en: Ana will have a margherita, and Marko a spicy one.

m4.speaker: npc
m4.sl: Same odlične izbire. Bi še kaj za piti?
m4.en: All great choices. Anything to drink?
m4.deliverySL: [warmly] Same odlične izbire. Bi še kaj za piti?

m5.speaker: npc
m5.sl: Takoj bo. Bi medtem eno solato za na sredino?
m5.en: Coming right up. Would you like a salad to share in the meantime?
m5.deliverySL: [warmly] Takoj bo. Bi medtem eno solato za na sredino?

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.sl: Ja, eno solato za na sredino.

m6.speaker: npc
m6.en: Here you are, enjoy your meal!

m7.speaker: npc
m7.sl: Vidim, da praznujete! Naj prinesem kaj za nazdraviti?
m7.en: I see you're celebrating! Shall I bring something to toast with?
m7.deliverySL: [warmly] Vidim, da praznujete! Naj prinesem kaj za nazdraviti?

m8.speaker: npc
m8.sl: Na zdravje in lep večer še naprej!
m8.en: Cheers, and enjoy the rest of your evening!
m8.deliverySL: [warmly] Na zdravje in lep večer še naprej!
